question: Can anything apart from the free Self be called liberation?
premises: Anything other than the autonomous Self is insubstantial.
Even if something insubstantial is posited, it cannot be liberation.
Such a thing does not even receive a separate name as liberation.
inference: Therefore liberation is not anything distinct from the free Self.
plain_english: Anything apart from the free Self is insubstantial, and even such an insubstantial thing cannot be called liberation; it does not even receive a separate name.
